name: demo-booking
description: Get a Demo booking hero (2026 Cal.com flow): heading, lead and the booking widget (work email, then first and last name, then our own week or month calendar on Cal.com's API; with details on, company name and phone are asked above the calendar and a click on a time books once they are valid; with details off the time click books at once; the booking goes on to the thank-you page). Split layout = copy and widget beside a testimonial card and an award marquee, fixed to one screen on desktop (live /get-a-demo/ and /get-a-quote-pro/); centered layout = copy, widget, stats and an award row (live /get-a-demo-month-calendar/).

layout.description: centered: everything in one column, stats and awards below the widget. split: copy and widget left, testimonial card and award marquee right; on desktop the hero fills one screen under the site header down to whatever follows it (a stats band, the footer), so the page does not scroll.

view.description: Calendar after the names: a week strip of days (week) or Cal.com's month grid with the day's times beside it (month).

details.description: Second step above the calendar (live config.details). on: once the calendar opens, Company name and Phone (both required) sit above the days; a click on a time books only when they are valid, and they travel to HubSpot (a second submission of the same form, or the guard's /update) and to Cal.com (booking notes, metadata, attendee phone when in international format). off: no details block at all; the time click books at once and the booking carries the name and email only (the pricing page /get-a-quote-pro/).

points.description: Optional bullet points under the lead (the pricing page's three). Each item is a string; only <strong>, <em> and <b> survive in it. On desktop they give way to the open calendar and to short screens.

background.description: Background image URL (one flattened image, covers the hero from the top).

button_label.description: Form button (live: Get My Free Demo; the pricing page: Let’s Get Started).

days_heading.default: What day is best for you?

times_heading.default: Pick a time to schedule your call
times_heading.description: Heading above the open times (the month view shows the chosen day there and uses this as its hint).

duration_label.description: Meeting length shown beside the time-zone picker.

compliance_label.description: Small label above the compliance badges beside the button.

compliance.description: Compliance badges beside the button. Each: image, alt, w, h (intrinsic size), display_h (shown height in px; defaults to h).

stats.description: Centered layout: numbers under the widget, counting up on first view. Each: value (e.g. 10,000+), label.

awards.description: Award badges (a row on wide centered screens, a marquee otherwise). Each: image, alt, w, h (h is also the shown height).

stories.description: Split layout: testimonials in the card beside the widget, auto-advancing. Each: title, quote, author, role, logo, logo_alt, logo_w, logo_h.

quote_icon.description: Quote mark image URL for the testimonial card. Empty uses the kit's.

cal_team.description: Cal.com team slug of a team event (e.g. asset-panda-sales). Leave empty when cal_user is set.

cal_user.description: Cal.com username of a personal event. Takes precedence over cal_team.

cal_event.description: Cal.com event slug (e.g. asset-panda-demo; the pricing page: asset-panda-pricing).

source.description: Source tag written into the Cal.com booking's metadata (live config.source; the pricing page: assetpanda.com/get-a-quote-pro). Empty falls back to the default.

max_days.description: Furthest day out a visitor can book (whole days).

hs_portal.description: HubSpot portal id the lead is captured into.

hs_form.description: HubSpot form GUID the lead is submitted to in the background (live demo 18622601-…; the pricing page 25dd36f7-…). Also sent to the guard as the form to forward to.

guard_url.description: REST base of the AP Demo Guard plugin (e.g. /wp-json/ap-demo/v1). Set: the lead goes through the guard, with a direct HubSpot submit only when the guard does not answer. Empty: straight to HubSpot.

work_email.description: Work-email rule. core: a visitor in the Core region (US, CA, GB, NZ, AU, read from the site's /cdn-cgi/trace) on a consumer mailbox (gmail, yahoo...) is captured as a lead but gets the 'a specialist will be in touch' card instead of the calendar until they use a work email. all: the same for every visitor. Empty or off: off (live since 2026-10-16).

track_path.description: The only page path that pushes conversion events to the dataLayer; anywhere else the widget books for real but counts nothing (the pricing page: /get-a-quote-pro/).

thanks_url.description: Thank-you page after a booking (the pricing page: /thank-you-pricing-multiform/).

thanks_preview_url.description: Thank-you page for logged-in or preview visits (live: the draft preview link). Empty uses thanks_url.

contact_email.description: Shown when no times are open.

contact_phone.description: Shown when no times are open.
